claims.claim: A hard-margin linear SVM maximizes geometric margin under separability constraints.
claims.notes: The hard-margin problem assumes linearly separable training data.

claims.claim: The soft-margin C parameter controls the trade-off between margin size and training violations.
claims.notes: The optimal value depends on feature scaling and validation protocol.

claims.claim: For the RBF kernel, gamma controls how quickly similarity decays with squared distance.
claims.notes: Gamma interacts strongly with feature scale and dimensionality.

claims.claim: SVM optimization and kernel distances are sensitive to feature scales, so preprocessing should be fitted inside the training pipeline.
claims.notes: The preprocessing fit must remain within each training fold.
